input.title: Give the FAQ search input an accessible name that matches its visible label
input.rationale:
The search box has a visible "Search questions" label right before it, but the label isn't linked to the input. It has no `for` attribute and doesn't wrap the input, so the input has no accessible name. I can only edit the input itself. The `<label>` has no id, so `aria-labelledby` won't work. Adding `aria-label="Search questions"` gives the input a name that matches the visible text exactly, so screen reader and voice control users hear and say the same words they see.

A better fix would be in the source: add `for="faq-search"` to the `<label>` on line 10. That links the two natively, and clicking the label then focuses the input. If the reviewer makes that change, this `aria-label` can be dropped. This patch fixes the missing name for this rule. It doesn't make the page compliant overall.
